DataFusion:
Sort: mean_reward DESC NULLS LAST, outcome ASC NULLS LAST
  Projection: AI.CLASSIFY(prompt(Utf8("Judge strictly from the conversation above how the agent handled the customer's request.

{0}"), t.transcript),make_array(struct(Utf8("completed the request"), Utf8("did what the customer asked")), struct(Utf8("refused under policy"), Utf8("declined the request citing policy and did nothing else")), struct(Utf8("offered an alternative"), Utf8("did not do what was asked but proposed and carried out something else")), struct(Utf8("transferred to a human"), Utf8("handed the customer to a human agent")), struct(Utf8("unresolved"), Utf8("the conversation ended with the request neither handled nor refused")))) AS outcome, count(Int64(1)) AS count(*) AS n, avg(t.reward) AS mean_reward
    Filter: count(Int64(1)) >= Int64(5)
      Aggregate: groupBy=[[outcome AS AI.CLASSIFY(prompt(Utf8("Judge strictly from the conversation above how the agent handled the customer's request.

{0}"), t.transcript),make_array(struct(Utf8("completed the request"), Utf8("did what the customer asked")), struct(Utf8("refused under policy"), Utf8("declined the request citing policy and did nothing else")), struct(Utf8("offered an alternative"), Utf8("did not do what was asked but proposed and carried out something else")), struct(Utf8("transferred to a human"), Utf8("handed the customer to a human agent")), struct(Utf8("unresolved"), Utf8("the conversation ended with the request neither handled nor refused"))))]], aggr=[[count(Int64(1)), avg(t.reward)]]
        ModelRegion
